parsed.explanation: No traveller-facing restriction is documented: no LGBT border screening or gender-identity question, no facility/bathroom ban, no custody-placement rule, no police profiling of trans visitors. Same-sex conduct legal since 1993; the criminal-code ban on incitement to anti-LGBT violence is actually enforced (fines); the Constitutional Court struck down anti-LGBT minors provisions (Dec 2024) and ordered partnership registration (Apr 2025); capital Pride has grown into the thousands. Against this: documented social hostility (workplace ridicule and psychological abuse, a 10,000-strong anti-partnership rally, hostile official rhetoric), a systemic lack of targeted hate-crime victim support, and a 2024 ombudsperson finding that police failed to protect an LGBT assembly — thin recourse, not state targeting. The absent gender-recognition route is a resident-facing gap and climate signal only. No trans-specific violence data, so that axis is undocumented. Worst feature is tier-3 hostility with weak remedy; no universal-exposure measure justifies a lower band.
